title: Driver shot dead by roadside in Buluan, Maguindanao del Sur
summary: A 45-year-old driver was shot dead by an unidentified gunman while standing at the roadside in Sitio Mahad, Barangay Poblacion, Buluan, Maguindanao del Sur, at about 2 pm on Sunday, 18 October 2026. The gunman fled; police found no spent shells and launched hot pursuit, dragnet and checkpoint operations.

sources.title: Lalaki patay sa pamamaril sa Buluan, Maguindanao del Sur

title: Coast Guard seaman killed, another wounded as gunmen fire on PCG vehicle in Cotabato City
summary: A Philippine Coast Guard seaman was killed and an apprentice seaman was wounded when two masked gunmen on a motorcycle fired into both sides of the vehicle carrying them and their station commander along Roman Vilo Street, Poblacion 6, Cotabato City, at noon on Thursday, 22 October 2026. Both were hit in the head; the seaman was declared dead on arrival at the Cotabato Regional and Medical Center. The commander was unhurt. Police recovered seven spent shells believed to be from a 9mm pistol; the gunmen fled toward the Texing and Washington area.

sources.title: UPDATE: Isa patay, isa sugatan sa pamamaril sa tatlong mga Coast Guard personnel sa Cotabato City
